title: prunella vulgaris subvar. surrecta
intro: Prunella vulgaris subvar. surrecta, commonly known as self-heal, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its small, blue-purple flowers and hairy leaves. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its health benefits such as wound healing and the prevention of infections. The therapeutic actions of Prunella vulgaris subvar. surrecta include its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis and allergies. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, particularly rosmarinic acid and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
